source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"A single, brief appointment with no further testing planned afterward","B":"Extensive medical, psychosocial, and support system assessment to determine transplant candidacy and readiness","C":"Evaluation of medical factors alone, with no psychosocial component","D":"A process with no established standardized components across transplant centers"}}
source_row.rationale: Heart transplant evaluation typically includes extensive medical assessment, along with psychosocial and support system evaluation, to determine both medical candidacy and the client's overall readiness for the significant demands of transplantation and lifelong post-transplant management.
source_row.source_name: UNOS / ISHLT — Heart Transplant Evaluation Guidelines
